caption: The drawing depicts a single black bow tie with a collar. The bow tie is prominent in the center of the image and features a large, neatly tied bow at the front, with two tails extending downward and slightly outward. The collar part of the tie is shown as a smooth band, with a black exterior and a tan-colored interior lining. Above and to the right, there is a lightly sketched, unfinished, or transparent outline of the same collar, but without any shading or detail. The background of the image is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or designs.
